subject.title: Feature: Default outbound topic/thread binding per agent for Telegram

question: Should Telegram add a per-agent outbound topic default, and what precedence should it have relative to explicit `threadId`, active topic context, topic-qualified targets, and account `defaultTo`?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new config/default surface and changes outbound delivery semantics for existing Telegram deployments, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Approve a Telegram-owned outbound topic default
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence first, then implement it in the Telegram topic config/schema and outbound threading path with docs and live topic proof.

options.title: Prefer active-context inheritance
options.body: Fix nested proactive sends by preserving the active forum topic context without adding a persistent per-agent config default.

options.title: Keep explicit targets only
options.body: Decline the new default and continue requiring explicit topic targets or `threadId` for proactive Telegram sends.

recommendation.title: Approve a Telegram-owned outbound topic default
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence first, then implement it in the Telegram topic config/schema and outbound threading path with docs and live topic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses current Telegram action-threading, shared outbound helper behavior, and config/default compatibility policy.
